task: Explore: build an instrumental variables research-algorithm tool (ventures/instrumental-variables)

errors.what: git stash -u (used to fast-forward onto origin/main) moved the untracked venture folder away while a 6-minute background coverage run was writing eval/coverage-output.txt; stash pop restored a 0-byte snapshot, and the run's output went to an unlinked inode.
errors.fix: Reran the study (another ~10 min). Next time: commit or move aside only files no background job writes, or fast-forward before starting long jobs.

errors.what: First coverage table counted empty Anderson-Rubin sets (possible when overidentified) as 'unbounded', which made 17 of 1,000 strong-instrument sets look unbounded.
errors.fix: Coverage script now tallies each set kind (interval, empty, two rays, whole line, open-ended at the grid edge).

errors.what: First 'weak' design (first stage x 0.15, F about 2) was too extreme to be informative; x 0.3 (F about 10) was mild enough that 2SLS still covered 95%.
errors.fix: Kept x 0.3 and added a weak + strongly endogenous design; reported that even it did not break the 2SLS interval, rather than tuning until it did.

errors.what: CI changed-ventures: engine.mjs held a literal U+FEFF inside the BOM-stripping regex (the editor wrote the character, not the escape); check_hidden_unicode.py failed. It is not in the local --for-changes run because no PR workflow runs it directly (the unwired-checks step does).
errors.fix: Wrote it as \uFEFF; check and its unit test pass.

errors.what: CI portfolio-pages test: ∞ on the page is not in platform/pages/entities.mjs NAMED_ENTITIES.
errors.fix: Used the literal character in the page script instead of widening the shared table.

errors.what: Copilot review on PR #17269 found 11 real defects, all fixed: AR grid called a tail infinite when it only reached the grid edge (an 80-row weak sample reported [-inf, 0.996] while AR(-21442) > crit); unadjusted first-stage F used RSS/n against F(q, n-L); Hansen J that could not run was read as 'instruments agree'; CSV split on ; and tab inside comma files; unit-dependent singularity threshold; text levels from dropped rows; baseline level dropped with --no-constant; no formula guard in the browser CSV export; W' for V' in the page's LIML formula; the page omitted the independence assumption; no warning that per-regressor F cannot show joint strength.
errors.fix: Engine: single delimiter, diagonal-scaled inversion, levels from kept rows, all levels without a constant, classical F, geometric tails + limit test for AR (truncated flag), error-aware reading, multi-endogenous note. Page: formula, guard, three IV conditions in FAQ and limits. 7 new tests (103 total); linearmodels reference still within 1e-11; coverage rerun: percentages identical, 3-5 'unbounded' edge cases now resolve as two rays.

doc_friction.issue: 'git fetch --depth=40 origin main' then merge: the first fetch (--depth=1) gave 'refusing to merge unrelated histories'; the deepen advice is right but the ff-merge needed a clean tree, and stashing untracked files is unsafe while background jobs write into them. A one-line warning would have saved a 10-minute rerun.
No guidance for reference-only Python packages (linearmodels, scipy) used to pin a JS engine; a plain venv in the scratchpad worked (same note as the propensity-score run).

notes: Explore idea: instrumental variables as a research-algorithm tool (ventures/instrumental-variables); 0 of 1,403 venture READMEs mentioned IV/2SLS. OLS/2SLS/LIML/Fuller as k-class; unadjusted/robust/clustered (+debiased); first stage partial/Shea R2, F, effective F (Montiel Olea-Pflueger); Sargan, Hansen J (two-step GMM), Durbin, Wu-Hausman, control-function; Anderson-Rubin set closed form (homoskedastic) or grid+bisection (robust/clustered). Pinned to linearmodels 7.1 on 3 specs x 6 SE settings: max rel gap 9.4e-12; AR endpoints vs scipy brentq 1.7e-13. Example: Sargan rejects valid county-level instruments (p=0.029) under clustered errors; clustered Hansen J p=0.14. Coverage (1,000 draws x 3 designs, clustered): 2SLS 94.5/95.0/94.7%, LIML 94.3/95.7/95.5%, AR 93.9/92.2/92.6% (empty overidentified sets count as misses); stated on the page's limits. Browser-checked at 1100 and 390 px with Playwright, no console errors. Local verification: run_workflow_locally --for-changes passed 12 workflows; portfolio-validate 100/100 locally; portfolio-pages locally failed only 'Check the built artifact' on dev/daily pages from local build ordering (GitHub's build job passed) and the ∞ entity test (fixed). After review: 11 Copilot findings fixed (see errors); coverage rerun with the corrected AR grid gave identical coverage and reclassified the edge-touching sets.
